name: Kouno Kenta
source:
He is currently unemployed and moves from one woman's house to another.

He is a liar and a frivolous person. He has been lying to his relatives, including Yuzuru's father, about his current situation. Taking advantage of the fact that his parents were away on their honeymoon after remarrying, he moved into Yuzuru's house.

He takes pride in his cooking skills, which are a result of his parasitic lifestyle, and specializes in stylish menus.  
He also has experience as an AV actor and is skilled in sex.  
He is careless about his relationships with women, but he has been able to charm those he likes with his bed techniques.
